title: Lawn match
hook: A **lawn match** is a live board match (Plants vs. Zombies: Fusion on your machine) — the **first core loop**, not the whole war.

blindSpots.meaning: The live PvZ board match on your machine, watched and fed by Rise of Summoner — not the rift map and not a web-only puzzle.
What you play first and what feeds almost every spine loop. It is not the win condition and not optional flavour.
What Rise of Summoner does **not** do. It observes, records, and can deploy demons back — it does not rewrite the binary.
Unlocked web features stay playable with the lawn game closed once opened. Nothing essential stays lawn-only forever.
Progress lands in your Rise of Summoner save. The lawn game’s own saves stay that game’s.

alsoTrue: A run feeds [souls](souls), type XP, [almanac](almanac), specimen levels, and [deploy](lawn-deploy).
Blessing, capture, trophies, and in-game open are still WIP — see sibling pages.

sections.title: What it is
paras: Legal Plants vs. Zombies: Fusion on your machine, with the control room watching.
You play the board. Rise of Summoner records what happened and can send roster demons back into the fight.
sections.note: Point the launcher at a legal install. Uninstalling the plugin is deleting a folder.

sections.title: What a run leaves behind
sections.intro: A normal lawn level ends when the wave ends. Here it leaves something:

cards.name: Souls
cards.body: Kills and victories feed the soul ledger.

cards.name: Almanac and types
cards.body: Plants and zombies you meet feed type progression and the almanac.

cards.name: Specimen levels
cards.body: Specimens gain levels from work they actually did.

cards.name: Deployed demons
cards.body: Bound demons you field fight with the traits and element you gave them.

diagram: legal match  ->  play board  ->  souls / XP / almanac / levels

groups.title: First session shape
steps: Start a legal lawn-game match from your install.
Open the control room and go to the Lawn stage while it runs.
Play the match; when it ends, check souls and roster progress in the Sanctum.
groups.note: Closing a menu over the lawn does not destroy the board — you stay on the stage.

doSteps: Open Lawn in the control room and confirm the live mirror is moving.
Finish a wave and look for souls / almanac / specimen progress in your save.
doNote: Read the board under pressure: [live mirror and unit HUD](lawn-mirror-hud). Field roster demons: [bound demon deploy](lawn-deploy).

mixUps.q: Is the lawn the whole game?
mixUps.a: No. It is the first core loop. Expeditions, map, and later places matter too.

mixUps.q: Do I lose RPG progress if I close the lawn game?
mixUps.a: Unlocked web features stay playable with the lawn game closed. RPG data lives beside the server.

mixUps.q: Does Rise of Summoner patch the game binary?
mixUps.a: No. It does not download, patch, or rewrite the binary.

mixUps.q: Are cheats part of this guide?
mixUps.a: Sandbox cheats exist for builders, off by default — not part of normal play guidance.

mixUps.q: Is blessing required to earn souls?
mixUps.a: No. Souls already pay from play. Blessing (WIP) is meant to boost later idle — see [lawn blessing](lawn-blessing).
